title: Apply fusion to factoring
summary: Migrated factoring to readiness-gated fusion: repeated factors retain exclusive ownership while arriving in semantic order, remain typographically rigid and nonzero, then retire together at one geometrically shared event where the common factor becomes the sole material owner. Factoring declares distribution fission as its explicit semantic reverse, and its choreography loads through the lazy algebra pack.
